categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Yitong High-tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three segments: manufacturing and sales of cable TV network transmission equipment including optical transmission, coaxial cable transmission, and data communication network devices; intelligent video monitoring engineering services based on cable TV network technology; and research, design, and sales of integrated circuits, chips, and health monitoring biosensors for wearable devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as PPG biosensor modules with self-developed analog front-end chips, ultra-low power AI processor chips based on RISC-V architecture, and integrated optical transmission systems. It employs a fabless model for chip design, outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging to specialized foundries. The production is customer order-driven with emphasis on product innovation, cost control, and quality assurance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include provincial cable TV network operators, government entities for video monitoring projects, and wearable device manufacturers. The company serves domestic markets predominantly in China, with expanding sales in Europe and the Americas. Its sensor and chip products are mainly sold to affiliated companies like Anhui Huami Information Technology Co., Ltd., and other smart wearable device makers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant revenue generated from the East China region. It also has a presence in foreign markets including Europe, the Americas, and other international regions, though foreign sales declined in the reporting period. Subsidiaries and R&D centers are located in Shanghai, Beijing, Hefei, Nanjing, and Shenzhen.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Yitong is positioned upstream and midstream in the supply chain, focusing on R&D, design, and manufacturing of core transmission equipment and semiconductor chips. It outsources wafer fabrication and packaging but controls key technology development and product integration, serving as a supplier to network operators and device manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in ultra-low power AI chips, PPG biosensors, and integrated optical network devices, aiming for technological self-sufficiency and innovation. It emphasizes expanding applications in AIoT, smart wearables, smart homes, intelligent transportation, and AR/VR. Collaboration with strategic investor Huami Technology supports large-scale market adoption and ecosystem integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of cable TV network equipment, sensor modules, and chips, as well as engineering service contracts for intelligent video monitoring projects. Sales are mostly direct to cable operators and government clients, with some licensing and technology service fees. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the cable TV equipment and semiconductor design industries, facing intense competition from domestic and international suppliers. It holds a recognized position in China’s cable TV network equipment market and is expanding its footprint in the wearable chip sector leveraging proprietary technology and strategic partnerships. Its competitive edge lies in integrated solutions and innovation in ultra-low power AI chips and biosensors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 101.3 million, a 44.41% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 38.86 million. The decline was due to reduced demand in cable TV equipment and increased R&D expenses. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 631 million, showing moderate growth, while R&D investment increased to over RMB 55 million, reflecting a focus on future growth despite current losses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Yitong emphasizes its core R&D capabilities, proprietary ultra-low power AI chips, and PPG biosensor modules that enable precise, continuous health monitoring in wearable devices. Its integrated hardware-software-algorithm solutions provide differentiated value in smart wearables, intelligent video monitoring, and cable TV network upgrades. The company leverages strategic partnerships to overcome market entry barriers and aims to deliver high-performance, cost-effective products tailored to evolving digital infrastructure and health monitoring needs.
